rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a certificate, especially one showing a qualification or status.

example.english: My certificate got damaged—can I get a replacement?
example.traditional: 我張證書整花咗，仲可以補領嗎？
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 zing3 syu1 zing2 faa1 zo2 zung6 ho2 ji5 bou2 ling5 maa3

rows.note: Use this when the document formally certifies a fact, statement, or status rather than an educational qualification.

example.english: The bank wants me to submit an employment certificate proving that I have a stable income.
example.traditional: 銀行要我交一份在職證明書，證明我有穩定收入。
example.jyutping: ngan4 hong4 jiu3 ngo5 gaau1 jat1 fan6 zoi6 zik1 zing3 ming4 syu1 zing3 ming4 ngo5 jau5 wan2 ding6 sau1 jap6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a document showing that someone has completed a course of study.

example.english: After we finish the course, the school will give us a certificate.
example.traditional: 讀完個課程之後，學校會派畢業證書畀我哋。
example.jyutping: duk6 jyun4 go3 fo3 cing4 zi1 hau6 hok6 haau6 wui5 paai3 bat1 jip6 zing3 syu1 bei2 ngo5 dei6
